intended_object: For a natural transformation i : H ⟶ G of group-valued functors on a category C, this is the canonical natural projection from (the underlying sets of) G to the pointwise left-coset functor X ↦ G(X)/i(H(X)), sending g to its coset g·i(H(X)). Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: At each object X, the component is `Quotient.mk''` into `G.obj X ⧸ (i.app X).hom.range`, which is the left-coset quotient (`QuotientGroup.leftRel`), i.e. the map g ↦ g·i(H(X)). Naturality holds by definition, because the coset functor's maps are induced by `G.map f` via `Quotient.map'`. The source `G ⋙ forget GrpCat` is the right one, since cosets of a non-normal subgroup form only a set, not a group. The construction already works for an arbitrary category C and arbitrary group-valued functors, which is its natural generality. Mathlib has no natural-transformation version of this pointwise coset projection; it only has `QuotientGroup.mk` for a single group.
